scientific_integrity: The period-four criterion and sharp invertible spectral gap follow from explicit integer state recurrences and a four-state induction. Direct full Fourier checks through eight rungs corroborate the proof. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: For open two-rail ladders only; complete nullity and nonzero spectral gaps in singular orders are not determined. Novelty assessment is bounded by accessible primary texts and targeted searches.
title: Period-four Fourier recovery from connected vertex sets of open ladders
